items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: The interviewee discusses Glenn Miller's band, arrangements, and other members (Tex, Al) but never claims a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with Glenn Miller himself.

ctx.x: Tex of course was the soloist, and he was the personality that Glenn Miller was trying to develop, and he did so successfully. But he and Al were very close friends.

I’ve always wondered sometimes, those solos from the Miller recordings, if they were improvised at the time. Because they became like THE solo to play. They actually would write them out, they were written out in the arrangements.
